date_note: Date is the publication day of the Pulse Ghana article reporting the arrests, which the article says took place on 13 and 15 November; the page gives no earlier disclosure day.
exec: Ghana's Cyber Security Authority reports two arrests in separate sextortion cases under the Cybersecurity Act, 2020.
geo_basis: arrests in Accra as stated by the source
plain: Ghana's Cyber Security Authority says it arrested two men in separate cases of sexual extortion, in which victims were allegedly threatened with the release of intimate videos.
summary: Ghana's Cyber Security Authority, with other law enforcement agencies, arrested two men in separate sexual extortion cases in Accra, Pulse Ghana reports. A law student was arrested on 13 November and a National Service personnel on 15 November; both face charges under Section 66(2) of the Cybersecurity Act, 2020. The Authority urged the public to be cautious with strangers online and not to share intimate images.
title: Ghana's Cyber Security Authority arrests two men in separate sextortion cases

validation.note: Single publisher (Pulse Ghana) relaying the Cyber Security Authority's statement; the Authority's own page was not read.

review.note: Compared arrest dates, Section 66(2), CSA advice against Pulse Ghana
